
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zylyehuo/p/20763467" title="发布于 2026-06-24 13:22">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Linux系统中网线与USB网络共享冲突</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<blockquote>
<p>博客地址：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zylyehuo/" target="_blank">https://www.cnblogs.com/zylyehuo/</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h1 id="问题描述">问题描述</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>网络管理器配置了“互斥连接”</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>有些配置会写成: 插入 USB 网络后，关闭 eth0</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>有线和usb共享网路，使用同一个网络协议，修改一个的时候会同时把另一个改了</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>系统把它们当成了同一个网络配置文件在管理。</p>
</blockquote>
<h1 id="给两张网卡创建两个独立配置">给两张网卡创建两个独立配置</h1>
<pre><code class="language-bash">nmcli device status
nmcli connection show
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>看到类似：</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-bash">DEVICE    TYPE      STATE        CONNECTION
eth0      ethernet  connected    Wired connection 1
usb0      ethernet  connected    Wired connection 1
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>绑定到具体网卡名</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>假设</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-bash">有线网卡：eth0
USB共享：usb0
</code></pre>
<h2 id="给有线网口创建固定-ip-配置">给有线网口创建固定 IP 配置</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo nmcli connection modify eth0-static \
  ipv4.method manual \
  ipv4.addresses 172.16.2.80/24 \
  ipv4.gateway 172.16.2.1 \
  ipv4.never-default no \
  ipv4.ignore-auto-routes no \
  ipv4.route-metric 500 \
  connection.autoconnect yes
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>eth0 只负责 172.16.2.x 局域网，不抢默认网关，不负责上网</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="给-usb-共享网络创建单独配置">给 USB 共享网络创建单独配置</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo nmcli connection add type ethernet ifname usb0 con-name usb-tether
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo nmcli connection modify usb-tether \
  ipv4.method auto \
  ipv4.never-default no \
  ipv4.ignore-auto-routes no \
  ipv4.route-metric 50 \
  connection.autoconnect yes
</code></pre>
<h2 id="重启两个连接">重启两个连接</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo nmcli connection down eth0-static
sudo nmcli connection down usb-tether
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo nmcli connection up eth0-static
sudo nmcli connection up usb-tether
</code></pre>
<h1 id="调整路由优先级-metric">调整路由优先级 metric</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>希望 USB 共享网络负责上网</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo nmcli connection modify usb-tether ipv4.route-metric 100
sudo nmcli connection modify ST1030 ipv4.route-metric 500
</code></pre>
<h1 id="看系统准备从哪张网卡访问-8888">看系统准备从哪张网卡访问 8.8.8.8</h1>
<pre><code class="language-bash">ip route get 8.8.8.8
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-bash">nvidia@EAORA04:~$ ip route get 8.8.8.8
8.8.8.8 via 10.163.44.252 dev usb0 src 10.163.44.216 uid 1000 
    cache 
</code></pre>


</div>
